approval_boundary.meaning: Approve the tested migration product and authorize only the exact additive copy envelope after prerequisite authority decisions are recorded separately.

claim_ceiling: This product candidate authors and tests an exact migration envelope only. It does not approve or execute migration, admit definitions or Artifact Types, activate imported material, delete sources, overwrite Lab bytes, commit, push, publish, release, or deploy.

causal_blockers: The Artifact Surface Foundation remains tested but unapproved and unadmitted.
Repository Migration Manifest Definition and Artifact Type remain candidate-unadmitted.
No execution authorization bound to this candidate manifest and receipt exists.
deferred_operational_residue: Semantic admission of imported packages remains one-package-at-a-time after byte migration.
Installed dependencies and compiled state must be reconstructed from locks and platform profiles, not copied.
Source retirement or deletion is outside this migration and requires a separate destructive decision.

operational_support.task: Admit the Artifact Surface Foundation and Repository Migration Manifest semantics/types if selected after product approval.
Execute the exact additive copy allowlist.
Commit and push candidate or executed migration bytes.

construction.product_frontier: One exact, source-preserving, additive repository migration candidate with complete source accounting, plane-local import mapping, executable copy semantics, rollback, and current product tests.
runnable_product_work: Inventory every source entry and classify it as copy-selected or explicitly excluded.
Bind every selected source file to one unique target path and exact digest.
Rehearse additive copy behavior without mutating the declared target.
Validate architecture, Artifact Type Request, Definition, Artifact Type, migration manifest, expected postimage, and rollback closure.

owner_intent.statement: I approve the CyberAlchemy-v2 to CyberAlchemy-lab migration and resulting architecture.
